title: Remote config: change app behaviour without an App Store release
subtitle: Small config file from the relay: switch listed features off, adjust limits, show notices, ask for updates

title: Ticket 01: Config model, store and relay route
Ticket 02: Wire the first uses and the screens
Ticket 03: Tests and a simulator check

text: Owner chose: build it now, trust the relay over HTTPS (no signing). Brief rewritten to match.
Writing the config model and the store that fetches and caches it
Relay now serves /config.json from a checked-in file (91 relay tests pass); app has the config model, fetch service and store. Not deployed: that stays the owner's call.
Hiding the Israel diagram overlay when the config says so, and adding the update banner and About row
Running the new remote-config tests and the debrief tests
35 new remote-config tests and 24 debrief tests pass (incl. the new report-window test). Running the full suite and a simulator check next.

title: Map with an update request and a notice (served by the local relay)
Settings > About showing the configuration serial and the update text
LLBG sheet: diagram overlay switched off by the config, chart sheet still reachable
A stale file (serial 1) is rejected; the saved serial 2 survives a relaunch
A newer clean file (serial 3) clears the banners

text: Full unit suite green on the 3rd run: 1131 passed, 0 failed. One unrelated location test (10 s wait, 8.9 s in a passing run) failed in 2 earlier full runs; it passes alone and when re-run. Follow-up for the integrator.

Simulator check against the real Worker via wrangler dev: banner and notice show, overlay switched off with the file's own message, stale serial rejected after relaunch, newer file clears it. Relay checked-in file restored; nothing deployed.

outcome: Remote config built and verified: relay serves /config.json, app reads it (update banner, notices, overlay switch, report-window parameter), 1131 app tests and 91 relay tests pass, simulator-checked. Not deployed.
